description.zh: 经典五子棋（15×15 自由规则，无禁手）。支持双人对弈与人机对战，简单/中等/困难三档 AI 会判断活三、冲四与双威胁；附带悔棋、坐标棋谱与胜负统计。
description.en: Classic Gomoku on a 15x15 board (free-style, no forbidden moves). Two-player and VS Computer modes with Easy/Medium/Hard AI that reads open threes, fours and double threats. Includes undo, coordinate move record and win stats.

controls.en: Click an intersection to place a stone
